G1300.b:
⟪δια-τελέω⟫, -ῶ
[in LXX: ⟦Deuteronomy 9:7|De 9:7⟧ (⁨היה⁩), ⟦Jeremiah 20:7|Je 20:7⟧, ⟦Jeremiah 20:18|18⟧ (⁨כּלה⁩), ⟦Ezra 8:13|Es 8:13⟧, II Mac 5:27 * ;] prop. trans., ⟪to accomplish⟫; used with ellipse of obj. as intrans. (Bl., § 81, 1), and joined to participles (in Ac, l.c., to adj.; v. Bl., § 73, 4) with adverbial sense (= ⟪continuously⟫), ⟪to continue⟫: ⟦Acts 27:33|Ac 27:33⟧.†

G1301.b:
⟪δια-τηρέω⟫, -ῶ
[in LXX for ⁨שׁמר⁩, ⁨נצר⁩, etc.; seq. ἀπό (for ⁨מִן⁩), as in ⟦Psalms 12:8|Ps 11 (12):8⟧;] ⟪to keep carefully⟫: ⟦Luke 2:51|Lk 2:51⟧; seq. ἐκ, ⟦Acts 15:29|Ac 15:29⟧.†

G1302.b: ⟪δια-τί⟫, T, Rec. for διὰ τί, v.s. διά.

G1304.b:
⟪δια-τρίβω⟫
[in LXX ⟦Leviticus 14:8|Le 14:8⟧ (⁨ישׁב⁩), ⟦Jeremiah 35:7|Je 42 (35):7⟧ (⁨גּוּר⁩), To 11:8, 12, Jth 10:2, II Mac 14:23 * ;] ⟪to rub hard, rub away, consume⟫; δ. χρόνον, ἡμέρας, ⟪to spend time⟫: ⟦Acts 14:3|Ac 14:3⟧, ⟦Acts 14:28|28⟧ ⟦Acts 16:12|16:12⟧ ⟦Acts 20:6|20:6⟧ ⟦Acts 25:6|25:6⟧, ⟦Acts 25:14|14⟧. Intransitively with ellipse of object (Bl., § 81, 1), ⟪to spend time, stay⟫: ⟦John 3:22|Jo 3:22⟧ ⟦John 11:54|11:54⟧ ⟦John 15:35|15:35⟧, ⟦Acts 12:19|Ac 12:19⟧.†

G1305.b:
** ⟪δια-τροφή⟫, ῆς, ἡ
(< διατρέφω, ⟪to support, sustain⟫), [in LXX: I Mac 6:49 * ;] ⟪food, nourishment⟫: ⟦1 Timothy 6:8|I Ti 6:8⟧.†

G1306.b:
**† ⟪δι-αυγάζω⟫
[in Aq.: ⟦Job 25:5|Jb 25:5⟧ * ;] ⟪to shine through, to dawn⟫: ⟦2 Peter 1:19|II Pe 1:19⟧ (cf. ἕως οὗ διαπνεύσῃ ἡ ἡμέρα, ⟦Song of Solomon 2:17|Ca 2:17⟧).†

G1308.b:
⟪δια-φέρω⟫
[in LXX for ⁨שְׁנָא⁩ (Da 7 only); ⟦1 Samuel 17:39|I Ki 17:39⟧, ⟦Ezra 3:13|Es 3:13⟧, al. ;]
⟪1.⟫ trans.,
⟪(a)⟫ ⟪to carry through⟫: seq. διά, ⟦Mark 11:16|Mk 11:16⟧;
⟪(b)⟫ ⟪to carry about, spread abroad⟫: pass., ⟦Acts 13:49|Ac 13:49⟧ ⟦Acts 27:27|27:27⟧.
⟪2.⟫ Intrans.,
⟪(a)⟫ ⟪to differ⟫: τὰ διαφέροντα, ⟦Romans 2:18|Ro 2:18⟧, ⟦Philippians 1:10|Phl 1:10⟧ (R, mg., but v. infr.); impers., διαφέρει, ⟪it makes a difference, it matters⟫: ⟦Galatians 2:6|Ga 2:6⟧;
⟪(b)⟫ ⟪to excel⟫: c. gen. ⟦Matthew 6:26|Mt 6:26⟧ ⟦Matthew 10:31|10:31⟧ ⟦Matthew 12:12|12:12⟧, ⟦Luke 12:7|Lk 12:7⟧, ⟦Luke 12:24|24⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 15:41|I Co 15:41⟧, ⟦Galatians 4:1|Ga 4:1⟧; τὰ διαφέροντα, ⟦Romans 2:18|Ro 2:18⟧, ⟦Philippians 1:10|Phl 1:10⟧ (R, txt.; for discussion and reff. v. ICC on ⟦Romans 2:18|Ro⟧, ⟦Philippians 1:10|Phl⟧, ll. c.).†

G1310.b: *† ⟪δια-φημίζω⟫ in late writers only, ⟪to spread abroad⟫: τ. λόγον (= ⁨הַדָּבָר⁩, ⟪the matter⟫), ⟦Mark 1:45|Mk 1:45⟧, ⟦Matthew 28:15|Mt 28:15⟧; c. acc pers., ⟪to spread abroad one's fame⟫: ⟦Matthew 9:31|Mt 9:31⟧.†

G1311.b:
⟪δια-φθείρω⟫
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨שׁחת⁩ hi. ;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to destroy utterly⟫: ⟦Luke 12:33|Lk 12:33⟧, ⟦Revelation 11:18|Re 11:18⟧; pass., ⟪to be destroyed, disabled⟫: ⟦Revelation 8:9|Re 8:9⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 4:16|II Co 4:16⟧.
⟪2.⟫ In moral sense, ⟪to corrupt, deprave⟫: τ. γῆν, ⟦Revelation 11:18|Re 11:18⟧; pass., διεφθαρμένοι τ. νοῦν, ⟦1 Timothy 6:5|I Ti 6:5⟧.†

G1312.b:
⟪δια-φθορά⟫, -ᾶς, ἡ
(< διαφθείρω), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨שׁחת⁩, and cogn. forms ;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪destruction⟫.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪corruption⟫ (physical or moral): of the grave, ⟦Acts 2:27|Ac 2:27⟧ (LXX), ⟦Acts 2:31|Ac 2:31⟧ ⟦Acts 13:34|13:34-37⟧.†

G1313.b:
⟪διά-φορος⟫, -ον
(< διαφέρω), [in LXX for ⁨שְׁנָא⁩ (⟦Daniel 7:7|Da 7:7⟧, ⟦Daniel 7:19|19⟧); also as in Polyb., iv, 188, al., Τὸ δ., τὰ δ., ⟪money⟫: Si 27:1 42:5, II Mac 3:6 ;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪different⟫: ⟦Romans 12:6|Ro 12:6⟧, ⟦Hebrews 9:10|He 9:10⟧.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪excellent⟫: compar., -ώτερος, ⟦Hebrews 1:4|He 1:4⟧ ⟦Hebrews 8:6|8:6⟧.†

G1314.b:
⟪δια-φυλάσσω⟫
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨שׁמר⁩ (as ⟦Psalms 91:11|Ps 90 (91):11⟧) ;] ⟪to guard carefully⟫ (M, Pr., 116), ⟪defend⟫: c. acc, ⟦Luke 4:10|Lk 4:10⟧ (LXX).†
a: A Grammar of N.T. Greek. Vol. I, Prolegomena, by J. H. Moulton. Third Edition. Scribners, 1908

G1315.b:
* ⟪δια-χειρίζω⟫
(< χείρ), ⟪to have in hand, conduct, manage⟫. Mid.
⟪(a)⟫ = act.;
⟪(b)⟫ in late writers (Polyb., FlJ, al.), ⟪to lay hands on, kill⟫: c. acc, ⟦Acts 5:30|Ac 5:30⟧ ⟦Acts 26:21|26:21⟧.†

G1316.b:
⟪δια-χωρίζω⟫
[in LXX: ⟦Genesis 1:4|Ge 1:4⟧ ff (⁨בּדל⁩ hi.), ⟦Genesis 13:9|Ge 13:9⟧ ff. (⁨פּרד⁩ ni.), etc. ;] ⟪to separate entirely⟫. Mid., ⟪to separate oneself, depart⟫: seq. ἀπό ⟦Luke 9:33|Lk 9:33⟧.†

G1317.b:
⟪διδακτικός⟫, -ή, -όν
(= cl. διδασκαλικός) ⟪apt at teaching⟫: ⟦1 Timothy 3:2|I Ti 3:2⟧, ⟦2 Timothy 2:24|II Ti 2:24⟧.†

G1319.b:
⟪διδασκαλία⟫, -ας, ἡ
(< διδάσκω), [in LXX: ⟦Proverbs 2:17|Pr 2:17⟧ (⁨אַלּוּף⁩), ⟦Isaiah 29:13|Is 29:13⟧ (⁨למד⁩ pu.), Si 24:33 39:8 * ;] ⟪teaching, instruction⟫, in both active and objective senses, most freq. the latter: ⟦Romans 12:7|Ro 12:7⟧ ⟦Romans 15:4|15:4⟧, ⟦Ephesians 4:14|Eph 4:14⟧, ⟦1 Timothy 4:6|I Ti 4:6⟧, ⟦1 Timothy 4:13|13⟧, ⟦1 Timothy 4:16|16⟧ ⟦1 Timothy 5:17|5:17⟧ ⟦1 Timothy 6:1|6:1⟧, ⟦1 Timothy 6:3|3⟧, ⟦2 Timothy 3:10|II Ti 3:10⟧, ⟦2 Timothy 3:16|16⟧, ⟦Titus 2:7|Tit 2:7⟧, ⟦Titus 2:10|10⟧; ὑγιαινοῦσα δ., ⟦1 Timothy 1:10|I Ti 1:10⟧, ⟦2 Timothy 4:3|II Ti 4:3⟧, ⟦Titus 1:9|Tit 1:9⟧ ⟦Titus 2:1|2:1⟧; pl., δ. τ. ἀνθρώπων, ⟦Colossians 2:22|Col 2:22⟧; δ. δαιμονίων, ⟦1 Timothy 4:1|I Ti 4:1⟧, δ. διδάσκειν, ⟦Matthew 15:9|Mt 15:9⟧, ⟦Mark 7:7|Mk 7:7⟧ (LXX) (Cremer, 182).†
SYN.: διδαχή
a: Biblico-Theological Lexicon of N.T. Greek, by H. Cremer. Third English Edition, with Supplement. T. & T. Clark, 1886

G1320.b:
* ⟪διδάσκαλος⟫, -ου, ὁ
(< διδάσκω), [in LXX: ⟦Ezra 6:1|Es 6:1⟧, II Mac 1:10 * ;] given as rendering of Heb. ⁨רַבּוֺן⁩, ⁨רַבִּי⁩ (NT, Ῥαββεί, Ῥαββουνεί q.v.); ⟪a teacher⟫: ⟦John 1:39|Jo 1:39⟧ ⟦John 20:16|20:16⟧; of Jewish teachers, ⟦Luke 2:46|Lk 2:46⟧, ⟦John 3:10|Jo 3:10⟧, cf. ⟦Romans 2:20|Ro 2:20⟧, ⟦Romans 2:21|21⟧; of John Baptist, ⟦Luke 3:12|Lk 3:12⟧; of Jesus, ⟦John 3:2|Jo 3:2⟧, ⟦John 3:10|10⟧ ⟦John 8:4|8:[4]⟧ ⟦John 11:28|11:28⟧ ⟦John 13:13|13:13⟧, ⟦John 13:14|14⟧, and often in Syn., most freq. in voc., as title of address, as ⟦Matthew 8:19|Mt 8:19⟧, ⟦Mark 4:38|Mk 4:38⟧; of Jesus by himself, ⟦Matthew 23:8|Mt 23:8⟧; of an apostle, ⟦1 Timothy 2:7|I Ti 2:7⟧, ⟦2 Timothy 1:11|II Ti 1:11⟧; of Christians, ⟦1 Corinthians 12:28|I Co 12:28⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 12:29|29⟧, ⟦Ephesians 4:11|Eph 4:11⟧, ⟦Acts 13:1|Ac 13:1⟧, ⟦James 3:1|Ja 3:1⟧; of false teachers, ⟦2 Timothy 4:3|II Ti 4:3⟧ (Cremer, 181; DB, i, 609, iii, 294, iv, 691)
SYN.: παιδευτής, q.v.
a: Biblico-Theological Lexicon of N.T. Greek, by H. Cremer. Third English Edition, with Supplement. T. & T. Clark, 1886
Dictionary of the Bible, edited by J. Hastings. 5 vols. (i-iv, ext. = extra vol.). Scribners, 1898-1904

G1321.b:
⟪διδάσκω⟫
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨למד⁩ pi., also for ⁨ידע⁩ hi., ⁨ירה⁩ hi., etc. ;] ⟪to teach⟫ (i.e. ⟪instruct⟫) a person, ⟪teach⟫ a thing;
⟪1.⟫ trans.: c. acc. pers., ⟦Matthew 5:2|Mt 5:2⟧, ⟦Mark 1:22|Mk 1:22⟧, al.; seq. ὅτι, ⟦Mark 8:31|Mk 8:31⟧; περί, ⟦1 John 2:27|I Jo 2:27⟧; c. inf., ⟦Luke 11:1|Lk 11:1⟧; c. acc. rei, ⟦Mark 6:30|Mk 6:30⟧ ⟦Mark 12:14|12:14⟧; c. cogn. acc., ⟦Matthew 15:9|Mt 15:9⟧ (LXX); c. dupl. acc, ⟦Mark 4:2|Mk 4:2⟧, ⟦John 14:26|Jo 14:26⟧; pass., ⟦Galatians 1:12|Ga 1:12⟧, ⟦2 Thessalonians 2:15|II Th 2:15⟧; c. dat. pers. (like Heb., cf. ⟦Job 21:22|Jb 21:22⟧, but prob. a vernac. usage, v. Swete, in l.), ⟦Revelation 2:14|Re 2:14⟧.
⟪2.⟫ Absol., ⟪to teach, give instruction⟫: ⟦Matthew 4:23|Mt 4:23⟧, ⟦Mark 1:21|Mk 1:21⟧, and often in Gosp., ⟦Romans 12:7|Ro 12:7⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 4:17|I Co 4:17⟧, ⟦1 Timothy 2:12|I Ti 2:12⟧, al.
SYN.: παιδεύω (cf. Westc., Heb., 402; Cremer, 180).
a: Biblico-Theological Lexicon of N.T. Greek, by H. Cremer. Third English Edition, with Supplement. T. & T. Clark, 1886
Commentaries on the Gospel according to St. Mark (Third Edition, 1909) and the Apocalypse of St. John, by H. B. Swete. Macmillan, 1906
Commentaries on the Gospel according to St. John, by B. F. Westcott, 2 Vols., Murray, 1908; the Epistle to the Ephesians, Macmiilan, 1906; the Epistles of St. John, Third Edition, Macmillan, 1892

G1322.b:
⟪διδαχή⟫, -ῆς, ἡ
(< διδάσκω), [in LXX: ⟦Psalms 60:1|Ps 59 (60) tit.⟧ (⁨למד⁩ pi.); Sm.: ⟦Deuteronomy 33:8|De 33:8⟧ * ;]
⟪1.⟫ objectively, ⟪teaching, doctrine⟫, that which is taught: ⟦Mark 1:27|Mk 1:27⟧, ⟦John 7:16|Jo 7:16⟧, ⟦Acts 17:19|Ac 17:19⟧, ⟦Romans 6:7|Ro 6:7⟧ ⟦Romans 16:17|16:17⟧, ⟦2 John 1:10|II Jo 10⟧, ⟦Revelation 2:24|Re 2:24⟧; c. gen. poss., ⟦Matthew 7:28|Mt 7:28⟧ ⟦Matthew 16:12|16:12⟧ ⟦Matthew 22:33|22:33⟧, ⟦Mark 1:22|Mk 1:22⟧ ⟦Mark 11:18|11:18⟧, ⟦Luke 4:32|Lk 4:32⟧, ⟦John 18:19|Jo 18:19⟧, ⟦Acts 5:28|Ac 5:28⟧, ⟦Revelation 2:14|Re 2:14⟧, ⟦Revelation 2:15|15⟧; ἡ δ., of Christ, ⟦John 7:17|Jo 7:17⟧, ⟦Acts 13:12|Ac 13:12⟧, ⟦2 John 1:9|II Jo 9⟧; cf. τὴν δ., ⟦Titus 1:9|Tit 1:9⟧; c. gen. obj., βαπτισμῶν δ., ⟦Hebrews 6:2|He 6:2⟧; pl., ⟦Hebrews 13:9|He 13:9⟧.
⟪2.⟫ Actively, ⟪teaching⟫: ⟦Acts 2:42|Ac 2:42⟧, ⟦2 Timothy 4:2|II Ti 4:2⟧; ἐν τ. δ., in the course of his teaching: ⟦Mark 4:2|Mk 4:2⟧ ⟦Mark 12:38|12:38⟧; λαλεῖν ἐν δ., ⟦1 Corinthians 14:6|I Co 14:6⟧; ἔχειν δ., ⟦1 Corinthians 14:26|ib. 26⟧ (DCG, i, 485; Cremer, 181).†
SYN.: διδασκαλία
a: Biblico-Theological Lexicon of N.T. Greek, by H. Cremer. Third English Edition, with Supplement. T. & T. Clark, 1886
Dictionary of Christ and the Gospels, edited by J. Hastings. 2 vols. Scribners, 1907-08

G1323.b:
† ⟪δίδραχμος⟫, -ον
(< δίς, δραχμή), ⟪worth two drachmae⟫; τὸ δ. (sc. νόμισμα, ⟪coin⟫),
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨שֶׁקֶל⁩ (⟦Genesis 23:15|Ge 23:15⟧, a1.), also for ⁨כֶּסֶף⁩: ⟦Genesis 20:16|Ge 20:16⟧, ⟦Deuteronomy 22:29|De 22:29⟧ ;] ⟪a double drachma⟫, nearly equal to the Jewish ⟪half-shekel⟫, the amount of the Temple tax: ⟦Matthew 17:24|Mt 17:24⟧ (DB, iii, 428).†
a: Dictionary of the Bible, edited by J. Hastings. 5 vols. (i-iv, ext. = extra vol.). Scribners, 1898-1904

G1324.b:
⟪Δίδυμος⟫, -ου, ὁ
(prop. name from δίδυμος, -η, -ον, ⟪double⟫, sc. παῖς, ⟪twin⟫) ⟪Didymus⟫, surname of the apostle Thomas: ⟦John 11:16|Jo 11:16⟧ ⟦John 20:24|20:24⟧ ⟦John 21:2|21:2⟧.†

G1325.b:
⟪δίδωμι⟫,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨נתן⁩ (53 words in all) ;] ⟪to give⟫—in various senses, acc. to context—⟪bestow, grant, supply, deliver, commit, yield⟫: absol., ⟦Acts 20:35|Ac 20:35⟧; c. acc. rei et dat. pers., ⟦Matthew 4:9|Mt 4:9⟧ ⟦Matthew 5:31|5:31⟧, ⟦John 1:12|Jo 1:12⟧, al. mult.; c. dat. pers., seq. ἐκ, ⟦Matthew 25:8|Mt 25:8⟧; id. c. gen. part.. ⟦Revelation 2:17|Re 2:17⟧; c. acc. pers., ⟦John 3:16|Jo 3:16⟧, ⟦Revelation 20:13|Re 20:13⟧, al.; δεξιάς, ⟦Galatians 2:9|Ga 2:9⟧; φίλημα, ⟦Luke 7:45|Lk 7:45⟧; γνῶσιν, ⟦Luke 1:77|Lk 1:77⟧; κρίσιν, ⟦John 5:22|Jo 5:22⟧; of seed yielding fruit, ⟦Mark 4:7|Mk 4:7⟧, 8; ἐργασίαν (Deiss., LAE, 117f.), ⟦Luke 12:58|Lk 12:58⟧; c. inf. fin., ⟦Matthew 27:34|Mt 27:34⟧, ⟦Mark 5:43|Mk 5:43⟧, ⟦Luke 8:55|Lk 8:55⟧, ⟦John 6:52|Jo 6:52⟧, al.; c. dat. pers. et inf., ⟦Luke 1:74|Lk 1:74⟧, al.; c. acc. et inf., ⟦Acts 2:27|Ac 2:27⟧, ⟦Revelation 3:9|Re 3:9⟧; c. dupl. acc., ⟦Matthew 20:28|Mt 20:28⟧, ⟦Mark 10:45|Mk 10:45⟧, ⟦Ephesians 1:22|Eph 1:22⟧ ⟦Ephesians 4:11|4:11⟧, ⟦2 Thessalonians 3:9|II Th 3:9⟧, ⟦1 Timothy 2:6|I Ti 2:6⟧, al.; ἑαυτὸν δ. εἰς (Polyb., al.), ⟦Acts 19:31|Ac 19:31⟧; c. dat. pers., seq. κατά (MM, Exp., xi), ⟦Revelation 2:28|Re 2:28⟧ (LXX); δ. ἵνα, ⟦Revelation 3:9|Re 3:9⟧; δέδωκα ἐνώπιόν σου θύραν ἀνεῳγμένην, ⟦Revelation 3:8|Re 3:8⟧.
SYN.: δωρέομαι.
a: Light from the Ancient East, by A. Deissmann, tr. by L. R. M. Strachan. Second Edition. Hodder, 1908

G1326.b:
** ⟪δι-εγείρω⟫
[in LXX: Jth 1:4, ⟦Ezra 1:1|Es 1:1⟧, II Mac 7:21 15:10, III Mac 5:15 * ;] ⟪to arouse completely, arouse⟫ as from rest or sleep: ⟦Luke 8:24|Lk 8:24⟧; pass., ⟦Mark 4:39|Mk 4:39⟧, ⟦Luke 8:24|Lk 8:24⟧; of the sea, ⟦John 6:18|Jo 6:18⟧. Metaph., of the mind: ἐν ὑπομνήσει, ⟦2 Peter 1:13|II Pe 1:13⟧ ⟦2 Peter 3:1|3:1⟧.†

G1327.b:
⟪δι-έξ-οδος⟫, -ου, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨תּוֹצָאָה⁩, as ⟦Numbers 34:4|Nu 34:4⟧ ff., and freq. in Jos;] in π. of the ⟪conclusion⟫ of a trial (MM, Exp., xi); ⟪a way out through, an outlet⟫; pl., δ. τῶν ὁδῶν, RV, ⟪the partings of the highways⟫: ⟦Matthew 22:9|Mt 22:9⟧.†

G1328.b:
⟪ἑρμηνευτής⟫, -οῦ, ό
(< ἑρμηνεύω), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨לוּץ⁩ hi., ⟦Genesis 42:23|Ge 42:23⟧ *;] ⟪an interpreter⟫: ⟦1 Corinthians 14:28|I Co 14:28⟧ (WH, mg.).† {Editor note:verse reference has διερμηνευτής, instead of this form}
a: The N.T. in the original Greek, by B. F. Westcott and F. J. A. Hort. Vol. II, Introduction and Appendix. Macmillan, 1881

G1332.b:
** ⟪διετής⟫, -ές
(< δίς, ἔτος), [in LXX: II Mac 10:3 * ;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪lasting two years⟫.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪two years old⟫: ἀπὸ δ. (sc. παιδός, or neuter; cf. ⟦1 Chronicles 27:23|I Ch 27:23⟧, ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς), ⟦Matthew 2:16|Mt 2:16⟧.†

G1333.b:
† ⟪διετία⟫, -ας, ἡ
(< διετής), [in LXX (Græc. Ven.): ⟦Genesis 41:1|Ge 41:1⟧ ⟦Genesis 45:5|45:5⟧ * ;] ⟪the space of two years⟫: ⟦Acts 24:27|Ac 24:27⟧ ⟦Acts 28:30|28:30⟧.†

G1334.b:
⟪δι-ηγέομαι⟫, -οῦμαι
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨ספר⁩ pi. ;] ⟪to set out in detail, recount, describe⟫: absol., ⟦Hebrews 11:32|He 11:32⟧; c. acc rei, ⟦Acts 8:33|Ac 8:33⟧; c. dat. pers., seq. πῶς, ⟦Mark 5:16|Mk 5:16⟧, ⟦Acts 9:27|Ac 9:27⟧ ⟦Acts 12:17|12:17⟧; ἅ εἶδον, ⟦Mark 9:9|Mk 9:9⟧; ὅσα ἐποίησε, -αν, ⟦Luke 8:39|Lk 8:39⟧ ⟦Luke 9:10|9:10⟧.†

G1335.b:
⟪δι-ήγησις⟫, -εως, ἡ
(< διηγέομαι), [in LXX: ⟦Judges 7:15|Jg 7:15⟧ ⁨מִסְפָּר⁩ ⟦Habakkuk 2:6|Hb 2:6⟧ (⁨חִידָה⁩), freq. in (Si 6:35, al.), II Mac 2:32 6:17 ;] ⟪a narrative⟫: ⟦Luke 1:1|Lk 1:1⟧ (cf. Milligan, NTD, 130).†

Impers., it seems, c. dat. pers.;
⟪(a)⟫ ⟪to think⟫: ⟦Matthew 17:25|Mt 17:25⟧ ⟦Matthew 18:12|18:12⟧ ⟦Matthew 21:28|21:28⟧ ⟦Matthew 22:17|22:17⟧, ⟦Matthew 22:42|42⟧ ⟦Matthew 26:66|26:66⟧, ⟦John 11:56|Jo 11:56⟧, ⟦Hebrews 12:10|He 12:10⟧;
⟪(b)⟫ ⟪to please, seem good to⟫: c. inf., ⟦Luke 1:3|Lk 1:3⟧, ⟦Acts 15:22|Ac 15:22⟧, ⟦Acts 15:25|25⟧, ⟦Acts 15:23|23⟧, ⟦Acts 15:34|34⟧.†

(δοκέω 2.): φαίνομαι; φ., from the standpoint of the object, "expresses how a matter phenomenally shows and presents itself"; δ., from the standpoint of the observer, expresses one's subjective judgment about a matter (v. Tr., Syn., § lxxx; Cremer, 204).
